mapper.select: /*selectCommonMpIvInvoiceDetailIKPopInfo*/ SELECT MAX(POHD.PO_NO) AS PO_NO -- 0 , MAX(WMS.INV_NO) AS INV_NO -- 1 , MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.BUYER )) AS BUYER_NAME -- 2 , MAX(DECODE(CMP.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N','코리아이플랫폼(주)',(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = IVHD.AGENT))) AS AGENT_NAME -- 3 , MAX((SELECT MAX(RD_DATE) FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO)) AS RD_DATE -- 4 , MAX(WMS.DELIVERY_DATE) AS DELIVERY_DATE -- 5 , MAX(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION -- 6 , MAX(IVHD.REMARK_INV) AS REMARK_INV -- 7 , MAX(DECODE(CMP.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N','KRKORE0001',IVHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_CODE -- 8 , MAX((SELECT LEGACY_PO_NO FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = WMS.BUYER AND PO_NO = WMS.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = WMS.PO_SEQ)) AS LEGACY_PO_NO , MAX(WMS.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) AS LEGACY_IV_SERIAL , MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'C019' AND CODE = WMS.DELIVERY_COMPANY)) AS DELIVERY_COMPANY , MAX(WMS.DELIVERY_NO) AS DELIVERY_NO FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD, ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMCMPY CMP, WMSIVDT WMS WHERE IVHD.BUYER = #{buyer} AND WMS.SELLER = #{seller} AND WMS.INV_NO = #{inv_no} AND IVHD.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND IVDT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND WMS.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND WMS.S_INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND WMS.S_INV_SEQ = IVDT.INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS <>'D' AND IVHD.STATUS <>'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <>'D' AND POHD.STATUS <>'D' AND POHD.BUYER = CMP.COM_CODE GROUP BY WMS.INV_NO

/*selectCommonMpIvInvoiceDetailIKPopInfo_v2*/ SELECT MAX(POHD.PO_NO) AS PO_NO -- 0 , MAX(WMS.INV_NO) AS INV_NO -- 1 , MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.BUYER )) AS BUYER_NAME -- 2 , MAX(DECODE(CMP.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N','코리아이플랫폼(주)',(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = IVHD.AGENT))) AS AGENT_NAME -- 3 , MAX((SELECT MAX(RD_DATE) FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO)) AS RD_DATE -- 4 , MAX(WMS.DELIVERY_DATE) AS DELIVERY_DATE -- 5 , MAX(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION -- 6 , MAX(IVHD.REMARK_INV) AS REMARK_INV -- 7 , MAX(DECODE(CMP.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N','KRKORE0001',IVHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_CODE -- 8 , MAX((SELECT LEGACY_PO_NO FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = WMS.BUYER AND PO_NO = WMS.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = WMS.PO_SEQ)) AS LEGACY_PO_NO , MAX(WMS.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) AS LEGACY_IV_SERIAL , MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'C019' AND CODE = WMS.DELIVERY_COMPANY)) AS DELIVERY_COMPANY , MAX(WMS.DELIVERY_NO) AS DELIVERY_NO , MAX((SELECT REPLACE(TEXT5,'param',WMS.DELIVERY_NO) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'C019' AND CODE = WMS.DELIVERY_COMPANY)) AS PARCEL_URL , MAX((SELECT PR.RECIPIENT_NAME FROM ICOMPRDT PR WHERE PR.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PR.PR_NO = PODT.PR_NO AND PR.PR_SEQ = PODT.PR_SEQ AND PR.STATUS != 'D')) AS RECIPIENT_NAME , MAX((SELECT PR.RECIPIENT_PHONE FROM ICOMPRDT PR WHERE PR.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PR.PR_NO = PODT.PR_NO AND PR.PR_SEQ = PODT.PR_SEQ AND PR.STATUS != 'D')) AS RECIPIENT_PHONE , MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C012' AND COMPANY_CODE = PODT.BUYER AND CODE = (SELECT PR.DELY_TO_LOCATION FROM ICOMPRDT PR WHERE PR.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PR.PR_NO = PODT.PR_NO AND PR.PR_SEQ = PODT.PR_SEQ AND PR.STATUS != 'D'))) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT , COUNT(WMS.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS INV_CNT , SUM(WMS.UNIT_AMT) AS INV_AMT FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD, ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMCMPY CMP, WMSIVDT WMS, ICOMPODT PODT WHERE IVHD.BUYER = #{buyer} AND WMS.SELLER = #{seller} AND WMS.INV_NO = #{inv_no} AND IVHD.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND IVDT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND WMS.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND WMS.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND WMS.PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND WMS.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND WMS.S_INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND WMS.S_INV_SEQ = IVDT.INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS <>'D' AND IVHD.STATUS <>'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <>'D' AND POHD.STATUS <>'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND POHD.BUYER = CMP.COM_CODE GROUP BY WMS.INV_NO

/*selectCommonMpIvInvoiceDetailIKPopList*/ SELECT B.BUYER_ITEM_NO -- 0 , B.DESCRIPTION -- 1 , B.SPECIFICATION -- 2 , NVL(B.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY -- 3 , NVL(A.INV_QTY,0) AS INV_QTY -- 4 , A.UNIT_MEASURE -- 5 , A.UNIT_PRICE -- 6 , NVL(B.ITEM_QTY,0)*A.UNIT_PRICE AS PO_AMT -- 7 , B.REF_PR_NO -- 8 , B.BYIT_COMORG_CODE -- 9 , B.CONTRACT_NO -- 10 , B.CONTRACT_SEQ -- 11 , B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT A, ICOMPODT B WHERE A.INV_NO = #{inv_no} AND A.SELLER = #{seller} AND A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.INV_QTY > 0 AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND B.SELLER = A.SELLER AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ ORDER BY 1, 2

/*selectCommonMpIvInvoiceDetailIKPopList_v2*/ SELECT B.BUYER_ITEM_NO -- 0 , B.DESCRIPTION -- 1 , B.SPECIFICATION -- 2 , NVL(B.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY -- 3 , NVL(A.INV_QTY,0) AS INV_QTY -- 4 , A.UNIT_MEASURE -- 5 , A.UNIT_PRICE -- 6 , NVL(B.ITEM_QTY,0)*A.UNIT_PRICE AS PO_AMT -- 7 , B.REF_PR_NO -- 8 , B.BYIT_COMORG_CODE -- 9 , B.CONTRACT_NO -- 10 , B.CONTRACT_SEQ -- 11 , B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMATCH WHERE DOC_NO = B.IMAGE_KEY) AS IMAGE_KEY_CNT , B.IMAGE_KEY , B.PO_REMARK FROM WMSIVDT A, ICOMPODT B WHERE A.INV_NO = #{inv_no} AND A.SELLER = #{seller} AND A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.INV_QTY > 0 AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND B.SELLER = A.SELLER AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ ORDER BY 1, 2
